title: Brazil opens familiarization period for SisGen 3 . 0
summary: Brazil began a 60 -day user familiarization period for SisGen 3 . 0 on 1 October 2026 . The updated software for the country’s genetic heritage and associated traditional knowledge management system was approved through Genetic Heritage Management Council (CGen) Resolution No. 53 , published on 28 September 2026 .

title: Peru’s chemical management regulation enters into force
summary: Peru’s regulation implementing Legislative Decree No. 1570 , the Law on the Comprehensive Management of Chemical Substances, entered into force in October 2026 .
